rule Suspicious_Rundll32_From_Temp {
    meta:
        description = "Detects rundll32 loading DLLs from Temp directories"
        author = "SOC Team"
        malpedia_reference = "https://malpedia.caad.fkie.fraunhofer.de/details/win.cobalt_strike"
        malpedia_version = "20260411"
        malpedia_license = "Creative Commons CC BY-NC-SA 4.0"

        $s1 = "rundll32.exe" fullword ascii
        $s2 = "\\Temp\\" fullword ascii
        $s3 = "\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\" fullword ascii
        $s4 = "\\Users\\\\[A-Za-z0-9]+\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\" wide
    condition:
        $s1 and ($s2 or $s3 or $s4)
}
